Maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw ~12% of spans dropped and an aggregation mismatch on user_sessions during the 18:00 deploy yesterday. outline below with owners and short timelines.

Ramon: ack. can you paste the failing query / sample logs?

Maya: pasted below. main issue seems to be a sampling edgecase in the tracing agent + an upstream ETL windowing bug that double-counted partial batches. tickets: OBS-9001 (missing spans), ETL-4123 (windowing), INF-2467 (reconciliation).

Alex: thanks. i'll own the ETL windowing fix, ETA: 48h for a patch + canary. will also add unit test for boundary windows.

Priya: i'll own the alerting/regression guardrails. plan: create an SLA check that triggers if span ingestion drop >5% for 10m and add a daily reconciliation job. ETA: EOD tomorrow for alert, 1 week for reconciliation job.

Jing: i'll add dashboards and a golden-sample check in redwood-observability to detect aggregation drift. putting up a PR today.

Maya: sample query for recon (run in analytics):

```sql
-- compare raw span counts vs aggregated sessions for last 24h
select date_trunc('hour', ts) as hr, count(*) as raw_spans, sum(session_count) as aggregated_sessions
from raw_spans rs
left join session_aggregates sa on date_trunc('hour', rs.ts) = sa.hour
where rs.service in ('frontend','ingest') and rs.ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
group by 1 order by 1;
```

Maya: snippet from logs when the drop happened:

```
2026-03-20T18:03:12Z ingest-agent[pid:4321] WARN sampling: dropped span batch size=120 reason=partial_window mismatch_id=0x9f3
2026-03-20T18:04:01Z etl-worker[pid:212] ERROR window-agg: incomplete-window flushed prematurely window=[2026-03-20T17:59:00Z,2026-03-20T18:00:00Z] job=etl-aggregator-03
```

Ramon: for the backfill/reconciliation, I propose two phases: 1) fast recon (fill missing spans by replaying raw S3 logs for the last 48h) - target: 24h to finish; 2) full correctness backfill for 7 days - target: next sprint. I can own phase 1.

Alex: noted. what resources do you need, Ramon? I can give a short-lived higher-concurrency slot on dedicated ETL pool.

Ramon: need temporary increase to worker concurrency and a throttle so we don't overload events-warehouse. also a small script to dedupe by span_id (we'll reuse INF tools).

Priya: i'll approve concurrency bump and will create the INCIDENT runbook snippet to track progress + add an on-call tag.
